## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe it.
Provide a clear and concise description of the problem, ideally with a step-by-step explanation of when/how you encounter the difficulty. (If it's an actual bug, report it as a bug, not an enhancement request.)

## Describe the solution or feature you'd like.
Provide a clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If applicable, include a mockup of the feature as you'd like it to behave. (E.g., a new logging feature that changes how events are logged.)

## Proposed YAML syntax (if applicable)
```yaml
# Show how you'd expect this feature to be configured in YAML.
```

## Alternatives considered (if applicable)
Provide a clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered that are already present in Main Serve.

## Additional context (if applicable)
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
